homescreen.help_title: Clock Point on your home screen
homescreen.help_intro: Tap the WinProx icon: on Android, Chrome asks to add WinProx to the home screen. After that you open the same Clock Point without a QR. No App Store.
homescreen.help_android: Android (Chrome): one tap on the icon. Confirm “Add to Home screen”. Sign in then works in that shortcut.
homescreen.help_ios: iPhone (Safari): Apple does not allow automatic install. Tap the icon, then Share → Add to Home Screen.
homescreen.help_existing: Still have an old icon where Sign in did nothing? Delete that icon, refresh this page and tap the plus icon again.
